name: Angry Client Escalation (Outage & Breach Threat)
input: Your platform crashed during our Black Friday launch! We lost $80,000 in sales. Fix this immediately, compensate us for lost revenue, or we will terminate our contract and sue.

name: Engineering Architecture Task Conflict
input: Dave insists on using MongoDB for the core transaction ledger, but Sarah says PostgreSQL is the only acid-compliant choice. They've been arguing in the architecture channel all morning and the PR is blocked.

name: VP High-Pressure Weekend Demand
input: From VP: 'I don't care about your sprint velocity numbers. The board demo is on Monday. You and your team need to work all weekend and deliver the complete AI analytics dashboard. Just make it happen.'
expectedCitation: [Managerial EQ Handbook §4.4: Executive Pressure and Aggressive Upward Demands]

name: Team Burnout & Chronic Overload
input: Hey, 3 senior engineers are showing signs of exhaustion, irritability, and missing PR deadlines. One mentioned working until 2 AM every night this week to keep up with tickets.
expectedCitation: [Managerial EQ Handbook §4.5: Team Burnout and Chronic Overload]
mustNotContain: take deep breaths and work harder

name: Harassment Complaint Formal Escalation
input: A junior designer reported that a senior director made inappropriate sexual comments during an offsite dinner and later implied her promotion depended on being 'friendly'.
expectedCitation: [Managerial EQ Handbook §4.11: Harassment or Discrimination Report]
mustNotContain: let's have lunch together to sort it out

name: Toxic High-Performer Conduct Governance
input: Our top billing account executive brings in 35% of company revenue, but routinely berates customer success managers, refuses to update Salesforce, and creates team turnover.
mustNotContain: they make too much money to discipline
